correctedState:
The divergence stands, with three corrections and one extension.

CORRECTION 1 — evidence pointer. Replace `hook-command.ts:336-378` with the two layers that actually decide it:
- `/Users/i.i.gavrikov/Desktop/work/nessy-desktop/packages/shared/src/automations/hook-command.ts:313-407` — `parseHookCommandOutput`, the whole event-specific extraction (`:443-454` `parseUniversalHookOutput` for the five universal fields). Neither reads `sessionTitle`, and `parseHookOutputForEvent` (`:464`) has no unknown-field passthrough.
- `/Users/i.i.gavrikov/Desktop/work/nessy-desktop/packages/shared/src/automations/hook-decision-contract.ts:39-49` and `:161-163` — `UserPromptSubmit` is a `top-level` event whose surface is `fields: ['reason','additionalContext']`, so `projectHookDecisionForEvent` (`:306`) would drop `sessionTitle` even if the parser learned it. Honouring the field means widening `PreToolUseDecision`, the parser AND this surface, then wiring a consumer — not a one-line parser addition.

CORRECTION 2 — the doc basis is stronger than the finding claims. This is not a whats-new-only line: `hooks.md` § *UserPromptSubmit decision control* :1195 lists `sessionTitle` in the event's output-field table, with the `hookSpecificOutput` example at :1205.

CORRECTION 3 — count. `sessionTitle` appears on five lines in `apps/viewer` (`App.tsx:202`, `Header.tsx:11,17,32,34`), not three; all are the unrelated React prop, so the absence claim is unaffected.

EXTENSION — the same documented table gives `UserPromptSubmit` a second non-decision extra, `suppressOriginalPrompt` ("If `true` when `decision` is `\"block\"`, omits the original prompt text from the block message shown to the user", hooks.md:1196). `grep -ran 'suppressOriginalPrompt' packages apps` → 0 hits in source. So the UserPromptSubmit band is missing two fields, not one.

Reachability, verified separately from the identifier: `UserPromptSubmit` is live on every backend — `pi-agent.ts:404` + `:6397`, `codex-agent.ts:455`, `nestor-cloud-agent.ts:267`, `pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.ts:120` — and `plugins/hooks-automation.ts:1696` consumes `additionalContext` and nothing else. Rename exists as a mechanism (`packages/server-core/src/sessions/SessionManager.ts:14134` `refreshTitle`).

Net effect a user sees today: a UserPromptSubmit hook printing `{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","sessionTitle":"auth-refactor"}}` is parsed, has the field dropped at both the parser and the projection, and silently does nothing — the session keeps its auto-generated title, with no warning to the hook author.

Filing note: this is the UserPromptSubmit half of the same missing band as f010 (SessionStart's `initialUserMessage`/`sessionTitle`/`watchPaths`/`reloadSkills`). Both belong on R9, whose recorded scope at `2026-07-26-r-queue-doc-verification.md:448` and `:462` already named `sessionTitle` on both events, rather than as two new rows. Do NOT implement in `plugins/hooks-runtime.ts` — inert-worklist §3 item 5.
